question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**prolific**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes Aristotle’s extensive writing and research output.
 
• The blank refers to the kind of researcher/writer Aristotle was — one who produced many works.
 
• "**Prolific**" means highly productive (especially in writing), which fits the context perfectly.
 
• Other options ("**lazy**", "**reluctant**", "**hesitant**") contradict the description of Aristotle producing about two hundred treatises.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lazy**: Means unwilling to work or avoidant of effort — contradicts producing ~200 treatises.
 
• **Reluctant**: Means unwilling or hesitant to do something — does not describe someone who wrote extensively.
 
• **Hesitant**: Implies uncertainty or pause — again inconsistent with prolific, sustained output.
